This 2020 Land Rover Range Rover Supercharged LWB represents an exceptional opportunity to own one of the industry's most capable and luxurious full-size vehicles, finished in striking Black with only 55,266 miles on the odometer.

- 4-Zone Climate Control with individual temperature management
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Steering Assist for enhanced highway comfort
- 360-Degree Surround Camera and 360 Parking Aid for confident maneuvering
- Head-Up Display projecting critical information onto the windshield
- Blind Spot Assist and Rear Traffic Monitor for comprehensive awareness
- Driver Assist Pack and Vision Assist Pack for advanced safety integration
- Adaptive suspension system for responsive handling across varied terrain
- 22-inch 5 Split-Spoke wheels with Gloss Black finish
- Premium Meridian audio system with 13 speakers and 380 watts of power
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Park Assist with High Speed Emergency Braking capability
- Heated and cooled massage front seats with 22-way power adjustment and memory functions
- Navigation system with InControl Navigation Pro and Traffic Sign Recognition
- Auto High Beam Assist and intelligent headlight cleaning
- Black Exterior Package including Narvik Black styling elements throughout

Powered by a 5.0L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, this Range Rover delivers commanding performance with real-world efficiency ratings of 16 city and 21 highway mpg. The Long Wheelbase configuration provides additional interior space and a more commanding presence on any road.

The interior showcases premium craftsmanship with perforated Windsor leather seating, genuine wood trim on the dashboard, console, and door panels, and a heated steering wheel wrapped in leather and wood. The cabin features suedecloth headlining and an overhead console with ambient interior lighting that can be customized to your preference. Memory functions for both the driver's seat and steering wheel provide personalized comfort at the touch of a button.

Climate comfort extends throughout the cabin via rear air conditioning, heated front and rear seats, and a heated windshield for year-round practicality. The front center console refrigerator compartment keeps beverages and provisions at the ideal temperature, while the HomeLink garage door transmitter adds convenient connectivity.

Safety systems throughout this vehicle provide multiple layers of active and passive protection, including dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. The electronic stability control, all-wheel drive system, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain composure in demanding driving conditions. Brake assist, ABS braking, and anti-whiplash front head restraints round out the protective equipment.

Advanced driver assistance technologies are seamlessly integrated throughout the vehicle's operation. Minocqua Chevrolet is excited to offer you this ...

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay
- Wireless Phone Charging
- 11.3" Advanced Color LCD Display with SiriusXM
- Heated Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control

This 2027 Chevrolet Equinox LT arrives in striking Radiant Red Tintcoat, combining modern styling with practical capability. The AWD system with 1.5L DOHC engine and 8-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance, achieving 25 city and 29 highway MPG for dependable efficiency on Wisconsin roads.

The interior welcomes you with comfort and convenience at every turn. Heated front seats keep you warm through cold months, while the dual-zone automatic climate control ensures each passenger finds their ideal temperature. The 8-way power driver seat with 2-way lumbar control adjusts to your preferred position, and the heated steering wheel provides additional comfort during winter drives.

Technology integration transforms your daily commute. The 11.3-inch advanced color LCD display serves as your command center, with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. SiriusXM with 360L trial subscription brings premium entertainment, and wireless phone charging keeps your device ready throughout your journey. The programmable universal home remote simplifies arrival and departure.

Safety and awareness features work continuously to protect you and your passengers. The HD surround vision system, interior camera, and rear camera mirror provide comprehensive visibility, while rear pedestrian alert and traffic sign recognition actively assist your driving awareness. Front fog lamps and auto high-beam headlights enhance visibility during challenging conditions.

Practical convenience touches make ownership straightforward. All-weather floor liners, a cargo mat, and the autosense hands-free programmable power liftgate demonstrate attention to daily needs. Remote start gets your vehicle ready before you step outside, while the backup camera and rain-sensing wipers handle practical demands.

This Equinox LT stands as a capable crossover designed for Wisconsin living reliable, well-equipped, and ready for whatever you encounter. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and explore how it fits your lifestyle.

Minocqua Chevrolet. No Games. No Gimmicks. Community Driven. Employee Focused.

This 2019 Volvo XC60 Hybrid T8 R-Design combines sophisticated design with practical performance, offering a vehicle that adapts to your driving needs with confidence and refinement.

- 4-Corner Air Suspension with Four-C Active Chassis
- 21 Alloy Wheels

The R-Design exterior styling kit distinguishes this model with refined details, while the gray finish presents a timeless appearance. Inside, the heated front R-Design sport seats paired with heated rear seats and steering wheel ensure comfort regardless of season. The leather and nubuck seating surfaces contribute to an upscale cabin environment.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the vehicle. The Graphical Head-Up Display projects critical driving information directly into your line of sight, while the 360-degree surroundview camera provides comprehensive visibility when maneuvering. Pilot Assist driver assistance and adaptive cruise control support safer highway driving, and the Sensus Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keeps you informed and connected.

The I4 supercharged engine paired with all-wheel drive delivers responsive performance suited for varied driving conditions. The four-corner air suspension with Four-C active chassis actively manages road imperfections, creating a composed and controlled driving experience throughout your journey.

Safety remains central to this vehicle's design. Dual front and side impact airbags, anti-whiplash front head restraints, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control work together to provide comprehensive protection. The emergency communication system offers additional peace of mind during your travels.

The Bowers & Wilkins premium sound system elevates everyday driving with studio-quality audio, while features like the power moonroof and power liftgate add convenience to daily use. This is a vehicle built for those who value both capability and refinement in their daily driving experience.

With its 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission, this Pilot delivers responsive performance while achieving 20 mpg city and 27 mpg highway. The front-wheel-drive configuration provides confident handling and reliable traction in various driving conditions. Comfortable leather seating accommodates up to seven passengers, with the third row offering genuine usability for extended family trips or cargo flexibility when seats are folded.

The Touring trim emphasizes convenience and connectivity. A Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System keeps you on course, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration ensure your smartphone remains seamlessly accessible. Bluetooth hands-free capability allows you to stay connected safely while driving. The premium 590-watt audio system delivers quality sound whether you're tuned to SiriusXM satellite radio or your personal music collection through portable audio connections.

Safety features throughout this vehicle demonstrate Honda's commitment to protection. The Lane Keeping Assist System actively helps prevent unintended lane departures, while the Forward Collision Mitigation Braking System provides an additional layer of security. A Blind Spot Information System alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, and the backup camera displays what's behind you during reversing maneuvers. Standard electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain secure footing in challenging situations.

Practical features enhance daily convenience. The power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless, and heated front and rear seats add comfort during colder months. Dual-zone automatic climate control allows front passengers to maintain individual temperature preferences, while rear air conditioning ensures comfort for back-row occupants. Premium 20-inch machine-finished alloy wheels contribute to both style and performance.

With 39,699 miles on the odometer, this Pilot offers excellent value and many years of reliable service ahead. Visit us to experience this well-equipped, versatile SUV firsthand and discover how it can serve your family's transportation needs.

This 2025 Nissan Rogue SL brings together smart design, advanced technology, and genuine value in a compact SUV that's ready to serve your daily needs and weekend adventures alike.

- Nissan Certified Pre-Owned with comprehensive inspection
- SL Premium Package with motion-activated power liftgate and panoramic moonroof

The blue exterior finish is complemented by 19-inch dark painted alloy wheels and practical exterior touches like splash guards and a chrome rear bumper protector.

We invite you to visit our showroom to take this 2025 Rogue SL for a test drive and see firsthand how its blend of technology, comfort, and efficiency can enhance your driving experience.

The 2025 Kia Sorento S in Wolf Gray delivers a refined three-row SUV designed for families who value versatility, comfort, and dependable performance on every drive.

This Sorento S comes equipped with features that enhance both convenience and your daily driving experience:

- Panoramic power sunroof with power sunshade and LED interior lighting
- Heated front bucket seats
- Power driver seat with lumbar support
- Leather steering wheel and shift knob
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Heated door mirrors with turn signal indicators
- Exterior parking camera with rear view display
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry
- Automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off function
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Cargo tray for organized storage
- Carpeted floor mats
- Roadside Assistance Kit

Under the hood, a 2.5-liter four-cylinder engine produces 191 horsepower and pairs with an eight-speed automatic transmission to deliver responsive performance. With an EPA-estimated 23 city and 31 highway MPG, this front-wheel-drive Sorento balances capability with efficiency for your daily commute and weekend adventures.

The cabin prioritizes comfort and safety with front bucket seats finished in SynTex artificial leather, a split-folding rear seat that maximizes cargo flexibility, and a third row of seats for additional passengers. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls, a tachometer, trip computer, and outside temperature display keep important information at your fingertips.

Safety technology includes dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and a rear side impact airbag system. Electronic stability control, traction control, and a four-wheel independent suspension work together to help you maintain control in various driving conditions. ABS brakes, brake assist, and low tire pressure warning round out the protective suite.

The Sorento S also offers power windows and steering, speed-sensing steering, speed control, and an emergency communication system for added peace of mind on the road.

The 2024 Chevrolet Blazer EV LT represents a thoughtful choice for drivers seeking modern electric capability paired with practical everyday features. This gray crossover is presented as a one-owner vehicle with a clean Carfax report and low miles, ensuring you're purchasing a well-maintained automobile.

- 8-Way Power Driver Seat Adjuster
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking
- HD Surround Vision
- Heated Driver & Front Passenger Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Wireless Phone Charging
- Programmable Hands Free AutoSense Power Liftgate
- Power-Adjustable Power-Folding Heated Mirrors
- Hitch Guidance and Hitch View
- Rear Pedestrian Alert and Side Bicyclist Alert
- Intersection Automatic Emergency Braking
- Reverse Automatic Braking
- 17.7 Diagonal Advanced Color LCD Display
- Navigation System with SiriusXM 360L

The Blazer EV LT arrives with the Comfort and Convenience Package, providing an 8-way power driver seat with 2-way power lumbar adjustment, complemented by a 6-way power passenger seat with its own 2-way lumbar support. Both the driver and front passenger seats offer heating capability, while the wrapped steering wheel features heating as well. These refinements create an environment focused on your comfort during daily commutes and longer drives alike.

Safety technology is integrated throughout this vehicle's design. The Convenience and Driver Confidence Package includes adaptive cruise control, rear pedestrian alert, side bicyclist alert, and an enhanced automatic emergency braking system complemented by intersection automatic emergency braking. The HD surround vision system provides comprehensive awareness around the vehicle, while reverse automatic braking adds an extra layer of protection when backing up. An inside rear-view auto-dimming mirror minimizes glare, and power-adjustable, power-folding, driver-side auto-dimming mirrors contribute to overall visibility.

The electric motor delivers an efficiency rating of 103 MPGe in city driving and 88 MPGe on the highway, translating to meaningful savings on fuel costs over time. The all-wheel-drive system provides confident traction in varied conditions, while the ride and handling suspension offers a composed driving experience across different road surfaces.

Infotainment and convenience features round out the package effectively. A 17.7-inch advanced color LCD display serves as the hub for navigation and vehicle controls, paired with SiriusXM 360L satellite radio access. Wireless phone charging keeps your device powered without cable clutter, and steering wheel mounted audio controls allow intuitive operation without taking your hands off the wheel. The programmable hands-free AutoSense power liftgate opens automatically when you approach with the key fob in hand, simplifying cargo loading whether you're carrying groceries or gear.

Additional practical amenities include satin aluminum roof rails for enhanced styling, hitch guidance and hitch view technology for towing situations, and wiring provisions for future trailer needs. The Blazer EV LT sits on 19-inch machined-face aluminum wheels with painted pockets, complementing its gray exterior. Four-wheel independent suspension with four-wheel disc brakes ensures composed handling and reliable stopping power.

This 2024 Chevrolet Blazer EV LT combines electric efficiency with the safety systems and comfort appointments that modern drivers appreciate. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it fits your driving needs.

This 2024 Honda Civic Touring in gray delivers a refined driving experience with practical features and solid efficiency.

- Bose Premium Audio System with 12 speakers and SiriusXM
- Honda Satellite-Linked Navigation System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration

Heated front seats and a rear window defroster ensure comfort throughout the year. Rain-sensing wipers detect moisture and adjust automatically, while delay-off headlights provide visibility as you exit the vehicle.

This 2024 Civic Touring represents a thoughtful balance of efficiency, safety, and technology. With just over 26,000 miles, it offers years of reliable service ahead. Come see this gray sedan in person and experience the refinement the Civic Touring brings to your daily commute and weekend drives.

This 2019 Honda CR-V EX-L in gray offers a well-rounded combination of capability, comfort, and reliability that suits drivers looking for a dependable crossover.

- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration
- Power Moonroof

The power driver seat features memory settings, allowing you to store your preferred position for personalized comfort during every drive.

This model comes equipped with comprehensive safety features designed to provide peace of mind on the road. The Collision Mitigation Braking System works with forward collision warning to help prevent accidents, while Lane Keeping Assist encourages proper lane positioning. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including overhead airbags further enhance occupant protection.

Technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the cabin. The audio system supports SiriusXM satellite radio for extended entertainment options, and smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected safely. The auto-dimming rearview mirror, compass display, and trip computer provide added convenience, while the HomeLink garage door transmitter simplifies entry to your home.

The exterior presents a well-maintained appearance with body-color bumpers, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and a power moonroof that adds airiness to the cabin. The rear window wiper and speed-sensitive wipers ensure clear visibility in various weather conditions, while automatic high-beam headlights with fog lights improve night driving safety.

This CR-V represents a solid choice for buyers seeking a practical, well-equipped crossover with strong features and proven Honda dependability. Visit our showroom to experience the comfort and capability this model offers firsthand.

Speed-sensing wipers automatically adjust their pace based on weather conditions, and the automatic high-beam headlights enhance visibility during night driving.

- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with voice-activated touchscreen navigation
- Front dual zone automatic climate control
- Heated ActiveX trimmed front sport contour bucket seats with memory function
- Heated steering wheel
- Power liftgate with remote keyless entry
- Fully automatic and rain-sensing headlights
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- 19 machined-face aluminum wheels
- Exterior rear parking camera
- Security system with panic alarm
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM stereo
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags with knee airbag protection
- Roof rack side rails
- FordPass Connect connectivity

The heart of this Escape is a 2.0L EcoBoost turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. This combination delivers the balance of efficiency and performance you expect from a modern compact SUV, achieving 22 city miles per gallon and 31 highway miles per gallon. The turbocharger provides responsive power when needed while helping maintain reasonable fuel consumption.

Stepping inside, the Titanium trim elevates the driving experience with premium comfort features. The heated front bucket seats with ActiveX trim and power adjustment ensure you find your ideal driving position, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth during cold months. Dual-zone automatic temperature control keeps all passengers comfortable regardless of the season. The SYNC 3 system with voice control and navigation puts information and entertainment at your fingertips without distraction.

Safety and visibility receive thoughtful attention throughout the design. The fully automatic headlights with rain-sensing wipers adjust to your environment automatically, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare from following traffic. The power liftgate makes loading cargo effortless, and the rear parking camera provides confidence when maneuvering in tight spaces. Multiple airbags and electronic stability control work together to help protect you and your passengers.

The blue exterior finish presents a classic appearance enhanced by body-color bumpers and a rear spoiler. The 19 machined-face aluminum wheels contribute to the Titanium's distinctive curb appeal while the roof rack side rails add utility for carrying gear. All-wheel drive capability helps you handle varied road and weather conditions throughout the year.

This 2022 Ford Escape Titanium combines practical utility with genuine comfort features. We invite you to visit our showroom to inspect this vehicle in detail and take it for a test drive. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you determine whether this SUV meets your transportation needs.

This 2023 Hyundai Tucson SEL Convenience Package delivers practical capability and refined comfort for drivers who value both style and substance.

- Power Sunroof
- 10.25 Digital Instrument Cluster
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Heated Front Seats
- Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Leather-Wrapped Shift Knob
- Dual Automatic Temperature Control
- Auto-Dimming Interior Mirror with Homelink
- Ultrasonic Rear Occupant Alert
- Power Liftgate
- Heated Door Mirrors
- LED Interior Lights
- 19 Machine-Face Alloy Wheels
- H-Tex Seat Trim
- Electronic Stability Control

The black exterior presents a clean, professional appearance accented by 19-inch machine-face alloy wheels and front and rear mudguards. The power sunroof floods the cabin with natural light while the LED interior lighting system creates an inviting atmosphere. Heated door mirrors ensure clear visibility in challenging weather conditions, and the power liftgate simplifies cargo loading.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully appointed cabin with heated front bucket seats finished in H-Tex trim. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add tactile refinement to every drive. The 10.25-inch digital instrument cluster presents critical driving information clearly, while the auto-dimming interior mirror with Homelink provides convenience and safety features.

The infotainment system integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to your digital life. Dual automatic temperature control ensures each occupant finds their ideal comfort level, complemented by the rear window defroster and air conditioning throughout the cabin.

Mechanical reliability comes from the 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission, delivering 25 city and 32 highway mpg. Four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control work together to maintain confident handling, while four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide responsive stopping power. Multiple airbags and the ultrasonic rear occupant alert system prioritize occupant safety.

Schedule your test drive today to experience this well-equipped Tucson. Contact Hiley Hyundai/Mazda of Burleson at or visit us at 320 N Burleson Blvd, Burleson, TX 76028 to see it in person.

This 2024 Nissan Rogue SV in blue represents a practical and efficient choice for drivers seeking a reliable compact crossover with everyday versatility and modern convenience features.

- Back-up camera with rear parking sensors
- Bluetooth and hands-free calling

The 1.5L DOHC engine paired with a CVT transmission delivers solid fuel efficiency, achieving 30 mpg in the city and 37 mpg on the highway. Front-wheel drive enhances traction and stability across varied driving conditions.

An overhead console, illuminated entry system, and front reading lights enhance usability. The power driver seat allows for personalized positioning, while the rear seat center armrest adds comfort for passengers. Split-folding rear seats expand cargo capacity when needed.

Convenience features enhance your daily driving experience. Heated door mirrors provide visibility in cold weather, while the rear window defroster ensures clear sightlines. Speed-sensitive wipers automatically adjust their frequency based on vehicle speed, and the variably intermittent front wipers respond to weather conditions. Outside temperature display and trip computer keep you informed about drive conditions and performance metrics.

Additional practical touches include front and rear floor mats with a cargo area protector to maintain interior cleanliness, a seatback protector, and a first-aid kit for emergency preparedness. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your hands on the wheel while adjusting entertainment settings.

Safety systems include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension with anti-roll bars, and a comprehensive airbag suite. The four-wheel disc braking system provides confident stopping power matched to the vehicle's dynamic capabilities. The suspension architecture is engineered to manage cornering loads and road irregularities effectively.

This WRX STi Limited combines Japanese engineering reliability with performance-oriented design. With 85,627 miles on the odometer, this vehicle is well-maintained and ready for the next chapter of ownership. Schedule a time to visit and experience the responsive steering, confident handling, and purposeful design that define this model.
